summary: Rapport Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten follow-on equity offering of 8,333,334 common shares plus pre-funded warrants for 1,190,476 shares at $21.00 per share (warrant price $20.999), grossing about $200.0 million before $12.0 million in underwriting discounts. A concurrent private placement at the same price, contingent on this offering, and a separate $150 million 2.25% convertible senior notes due 2032 offering are underway; combined gross proceeds are roughly $230 million. Morgan Stanley, Leerink Partners and Evercore are underwriters; last sale was $27.54 on October 27, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; watch pricing pressure from the discount and simultaneous convert.
